title: Kumba Resources Limited - proposed acquisition of Ticor Limited
industries: Mineral sands and titanium dioxide pigment

body_sections.Summary: Proposed acquisition of Ticor Ltd by Kumba Resources Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: 1. The national market for the mining and processing of heavy mineral sands into upgraded titanium dioxide feedstocks; and 2. The national market for the production of titanium dioxide pigment
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 24 June 2005, the ACCC formed a view not to oppose Kumba's purchase of the remaining shares in Ticor that it did not already control. Kumba's only presence in Australian mineral sands operations are made up by its existing interests in Ticor and its minority interest in a small Australian processor, Mineral Deposits Ltd. It appears that titanium dioxide feedstocks and pigment are globally traded products and that international producers could readily expand their supply to Australian customers in the event of any attempted price increase in Australia. There also appears to be substantial countervailing power for both titanium dioxide feedstock and pigment. Accordingly, the proposed acquisition appears unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets pursuant to section 50 of the Act.
